import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/rollout-20261007")
expected="1d92d174d49e058e0dfe46d55b5fe7bceba70fe5"
def run(args,check=True):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check)
head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected or branch!="feat/staged-runtime-rollout-20261007" or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} branch={branch} status={status!r}")

print(push.stdout); print(push.stderr); print("push_rc="+str(push.returncode))
if push.returncode: raise SystemExit(push.returncode)
remote=run(["git","ls-remote","origin",f"refs/heads/{branch}"]).stdout.strip()
print("remote_ref="+remote)
if expected not in remote: raise SystemExit("remote mismatch")
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
